description: Pages in the signed-in person's OneNote, newest first: in one section (section_id) or across all notebooks. title_contains filters by title. Returns page_id. Read-only. Sign-in required.

section_id.description: Optional. section_id from list_onenote_notebooks. Omit to list across all notebooks.

title_contains.description: Optional. Only pages whose title contains these words (not case sensitive).

name: list_onenote_pages
title: List my OneNote pages
